extraction_notes: Supplementary Tables S1–S4 are referenced but not included in the provided full text; exact values there were not extracted. Figure 2 and Figure 3a graphical values were read approximately from labelled axes and marked with qualifier '~' unless printed in text. Figure 3b reports cumulative ammonia production versus time, not rate/outlet NH3/TOF, so it was not encoded as performance records. Figure 4b reports logarithmic kinetic plots versus partial pressures; because the plotted ordinate is log(rate) and the exact feed compositions/partial pressures for each point are not printed, these points were not converted into direct rate records.
